decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures separate LED power control, but the tentative statement that a shifter might not be needed does not safely establish whether data_level_shifting or level_shifter_part should change.

Separate LED and sensor control may make the existing single-rail 5V_EN function description stale, but the source does not identify the resulting connector signals or whether the original master enable remains.
Separating LED and sensor power control does not necessarily change the requirement to monitor the 3.3V and 5V rails or the selected monitor device.
The source changes control of 5V LED and sensor loads, not DCDC1 regulation or its current 3.3V load coverage.
The separate control concerns LED and sensor power on the 5V side and does not alter the standalone USB 3.3V supply behavior established for this Requirement.
Separate downstream load control does not change the AXP2101 battery input or its role as the normal system power source.
The source does not change how charge status is displayed or the dedicated CHGLED interface.
LED-versus-sensor power control is unrelated to the battery connector family, pin count, or pinout.
The source does not affect battery protection requirements, cutoff thresholds, or protection components.
The source does not affect the battery NTC terminal, thermal monitoring function, or controller.
The source does not identify a new GPIO assignment or replace GPIO5; a separate control cannot be mapped to a pin from this evidence.
Separate LED and sensor power control does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, routing, cable length, or bus speed.
